use bignum::{BigNum, BLS12_381_Fr};
use types::constants::FIELDS_PER_BLOB;

pub global LOG_FIELDS_PER_BLOB: u32 = 12;
pub global D: BLS12_381_Fr = BLS12_381_Fr::from_limbs([4096, 0, 0]);
pub global D_INV: BLS12_381_Fr = BLS12_381_Fr::from_limbs([
    0x686828bfce5c19400fffff00100001,
    0x6878b46ae3705eb6a46a89213de7d3,
    0x73e6,
]);

#[test]
fn test_d() {
    let limbs = D.get_limbs();
    assert(limbs[0] == FIELDS_PER_BLOB as u128);
    assert(limbs[1] == 0);
    assert(limbs[2] == 0);
}

#[test]
fn test_log_fields_per_blob() {
    assert(1 << LOG_FIELDS_PER_BLOB == FIELDS_PER_BLOB, "Incorrect LOG_FIELDS_PER_BLOB");
}

mod tests {
    use super::{LOG_FIELDS_PER_BLOB, ROOTS};
    use bignum::{BigNum, BLS12_381_Fr};
    use types::constants::FIELDS_PER_BLOB;

    unconstrained fn compute_level(idx_: u32) -> u32 {
        // Count the number of trailing ones.
        let mut count = 0;
        let mut idx = idx_;
        for _i in 0..LOG_FIELDS_PER_BLOB {
            if (idx & 1 == 0) {
                break;
            } else {
                count += 1;
                idx >>= 1;
            }
        }

        count
    }

    unconstrained fn compute_big_minus_arr(
        _big_minus: u32,
        _next_diff: u32,
    ) -> [u32; LOG_FIELDS_PER_BLOB - 2] {
        let mut res: [u32; LOG_FIELDS_PER_BLOB - 2] = [0; LOG_FIELDS_PER_BLOB - 2];
        let mut big_minus = _big_minus;
        let mut next_diff = _next_diff;
        res[0] = big_minus;
        for i in 1..LOG_FIELDS_PER_BLOB - 2 {
            next_diff >>= 1;
            big_minus += next_diff;
            res[i] = big_minus;
        }
        assert(next_diff == 3);
        res
    }

    unconstrained fn bit_reversal_permutation(
        arr: [BLS12_381_Fr; FIELDS_PER_BLOB],
    ) -> [BLS12_381_Fr; FIELDS_PER_BLOB] {
        let mut arr_brp: [BLS12_381_Fr; FIELDS_PER_BLOB] = [BigNum::zero(); FIELDS_PER_BLOB];
        let PLUS = FIELDS_PER_BLOB >> 1;
        let MINUS = PLUS >> 1;
        let mut I = 0;
        let next_diff = PLUS - (MINUS >> 1);
        let big_minus = next_diff + MINUS;

        let big_minus_arr = compute_big_minus_arr(big_minus, next_diff);

        arr_brp[0] = arr[0];
        I += PLUS;
        arr_brp[1] = arr[I];
        I -= MINUS;
        arr_brp[2] = arr[I];
        I += PLUS;
        arr_brp[3] = arr[I];

        for i in 0..FIELDS_PER_BLOB / 4 - 1 {
            let j = 4 * i + 4;
            let level = compute_level(i);
            I -= big_minus_arr[level];
            arr_brp[j] = arr[I];
            I += PLUS;
            arr_brp[j + 1] = arr[I];
            I -= MINUS;
            arr_brp[j + 2] = arr[I];
            I += PLUS;
            arr_brp[j + 3] = arr[I];
        }
        arr_brp
    }

    // x ^ i for i in 0..4096
    unconstrained fn compute_powers(x: BLS12_381_Fr) -> [BLS12_381_Fr; FIELDS_PER_BLOB] {
        let mut powers = [BLS12_381_Fr::zero(); FIELDS_PER_BLOB];
        let mut current_power = BLS12_381_Fr::one();
        for i in 0..FIELDS_PER_BLOB {
            powers[i] = current_power;
            current_power = current_power.__mul(x);
        }
        powers
    }

    unconstrained fn compute_roots_of_unity() -> [BLS12_381_Fr; FIELDS_PER_BLOB] {
        // The below const is found from:
        // let order: F = BigNum { limbs: [ FIELDS_PER_BLOB, 0, 0 ];
        // let exp = BLS_MODULUS_SUB_1.udiv_mod(order);
        // let exp: F = BigNum { limbs: [ 0x553bda402fffe5bfeffffffff00000, 0x3eda753299d7d483339d80809a1d80, 0x000007 ] }; // (MODULUS - 1) // 4096
        // let root_of_unity = PRIMITIVE_ROOT_OF_UNITY.__pow(exp);
        let root_of_unity = BLS12_381_Fr::from_limbs([
            0xd1347b378fbf96e206da11a5d36306,
            0x0a11a0f704f4fc3e8acfe0f8245f0a,
            0x00564c,
        ]);
        let roots_of_unity = compute_powers(root_of_unity);
        bit_reversal_permutation(roots_of_unity)
    }

    #[test]
    unconstrained fn test_roots_correctness() {
        assert_eq(compute_roots_of_unity(), ROOTS);
    }
}
